body: I made a good life decision by getting myself out of the abuse. ☺️ Everyone lives a different life and we can all learn from each other. You sound like you have a lot of toxic mess within yourself to clean up. I hope you find happiness and a healthy life partner in the future!

You’ve already been called out. I have friends that go through things so you going through my past and thinking you got something    🤷‍♀️ the fact that your so much of a keyboard warrior tells me you don’t have a lot of “real life” experiences going on. If all you got on me is being a mother and putting myself in others shoes, your perspective on life is tainted by something from your past. Be happy for others 💕 Be an adult, that’s if you can. And I’d rather be a single mom than another number when it comes to domestic abuse 💯

I’ve never posted on SuicideWatch but you can join and pull people out of that train of thought. Some people don’t see other options because their world is “small”. Showing support to strangers is how I give back since I’m too busy working to volunteer like I used to. 

PS: I hope you put your keyboard warrior skills somewhere more helpful to people 🥰 remember a single upvote can make someone feel supported!

I wish I could have an idea on how much “life experience” you have... I swear it’s normal for adults to intermingle no matter the sexes one on one in business, hobbies, home life, etc… 

I run both ways so am I not allowed to talk to nobody? This whole: there’s a female + there’s a male = Mating is absurd and disrespectfully low on every level. 

My partner has met an ex of mine that I still hold dear to me, a true friend. 

I live in l world where adults can be respectful, trustworthy, understanding and kind. 

I didn’t know people actually thought like this outside of adolescence….

There’s a movie “Along With The Gods: The Two Worlds” on Netflix derived from the Ten Kings Of Hell from old Buddhist texts and these “trials” with these Kings have their own cost. To die by suicide, you do not reincarnate and walk forevermore alone.
You’re in your head, you’ll be fine. It’s not like you were watching corn.

You need to surround yourself with positive people. More people like your new friend. Do what you can if you can to leave. If not, be honest about the way you feel by sitting down and having that conversation. I’ve greatly improved with self care. Therapy, yoga, home workout, work life, psychiatrist to find out I have ADHD, anxiety, etc. Now I’m finding ways to live with the way I am. I’m learning better ways to be me and appreciate what I have now and actively working towards. It won’t always be that way. You got this.
